summary: Nix research program phase 6 after a dive wave: one opus agent harvests the new consolidations, appends the landing report to the topic map, applies the stop condition, and commissions the next wave (revised staged briefs plus follow-ups) or declares ready-to-draft with binding authoring notes
logs: Verdict: ready-to-draft · rerun 0 · next wave 0 · IDs 138 · MUST 83 · families 9 · contradictions 18

harvest.verdict_reason: Not converged by the strict stop condition: wave 4 plus the wave-3 reruns added 23 MUSTs (LANG 6, SEC 7, MOD 5, plus PKG-19, PKG-21, REL-13 raised, GEN-21, GEN-22) and one new failure class (C25, composition-only failure), and no held-out round has run. The tail is still closed. Every remaining open question falls into one of four kinds: a dated re-check, a measurement this rig cannot supply (Darwin/aarch64, real CI runners, Determinate, HTTPS LFS), an owner decision with a default applied, or an answerable refinement that cannot overturn a MUST. The refinements include M-B-17, the watchdog false positive, #3872, Lix enumeration, SEC floor parity, module hosts and floors, ocx determinism, and the GEN Nix-level twins. None is both load-bearing and answerable. Three kinds of work move to phases 7 and 8 as binding obligations: the unrun or lost verifications (every fixture except nix-generated-flakes-rev3/ is gone), three scope edits (E28, E29, E42), and the held-out sweep.
frame_corrections: H8 corrected in scale: 2 of 11 nixConfig declarers exceed the allowlist (nix-vscode-extensions extra-trusted-substituters with hydra.iohk.io; llm-agents.nix allow-import-from-derivation). 8 of 36 non-implementation repos pass --accept-flake-config, including an AGENTS.md and CI accepting a third-party flake on a floating ref. A post-build-hook executes once the flag is accepted (reproduced). Trust is stored per (setting, value), not per flake [sec].

H9 sharpened: Lix 2.95.2 accepts unknown apps attributes (third leniency gap after formatter and overlay arity). It rejects all four mixed-rec attrpath shapes that CppNix accepts, and it defaults IFD to true like CppNix. lint-url-literals works from CppNix 2.34 and is a silent unknown-setting no-op on 2.31.5 [lang conflicts 1, 12].

New: a secret reaches the mode-444 store without ever being read. A tracked, never-read file is copied once self is interpolated, and a fetcher header is in the .drv after nix eval alone [sec Verdict 4].
New: inspecting a flake you do not own is unsafe beyond IFD. nix develop runs the shellHook as the user, and show and check --no-build build IFD by default [sec Verdict 5].

New failure class C25: an exported module or Python library fails only when a consumer composes it (duplicate import, readOnlyPkgs, wrong _class, top-level flake-parts option, top-level-only Python export).
Frame corpus description wrong: the nixpkgs clone is the full ~4.5M-line pkgs/ tree and dominates per-line rates 20:1, so every corpus rate must say whether it excludes NixOS__nixpkgs.
Q7 stands, but modules.md ships anyway for adopters and templates. NixOS/templates is the worst module violator.

Fleet data: grimoire-rs/grimoire@55f839ce31fb has no flake.nix and carries LFS files its build never reads. ocx has three submodules, 10 git-sourced crates from 2 revs, no --version flag (it has a version subcommand) and a 7m12s per-PR build. All three fleet packages are Apache-2.0.
Tooling: nix-update's missing write-back comes from replace_hash text-matching the evaluated hash, not from nested bwrap. Determinate Nix is not in nixpkgs, so this rig cannot run it.

Environment: an external cleanup deleted ~/.cache/research-lang. The toolchain is rebuilt (run.sh prints 2.35.2, re-checked) and the 38 exemplars are back at their cited SHAs. All fixture trees except nix-generated-flakes-rev3/ are gone, so the cited fixture paths dangle. GitHub's REST API returns schema stubs in this sandbox. The receipt's NIX-LANG must_count 5 is wrong; the file carries 6.
contradictions_across_consolidations: E28 NIX-FLK-15 and NIX-REL-16 prove the release with -- --version, but ocx has no --version (NIX-PKG-19). PKG-19 keeps its text. FLK-15 and REL-16 run the version entry point PKG-19 names; for ocx that is -- version.

E29 NIX-REL-09 and REL-16 bind A and D, but a D flake has no packages.default and no tags (GEN-13, REL-07). REL-16 now binds A only, and D uses GEN-15 plus executed nix run examples. REL-09 keeps the A block. A D README names a single-binary attribute and uses nix shell for multi-binary packages.

E30 NIX-SEC-02 (repo-wide grep, empty output passes) vs REL-09's README-only grep and REL failure mode 9, which still uses Q13's 'warning against it' wording. SEC-02 keeps the rule, and the Q13 wording is struck.
E31 NIX-SEC-05 vs INP-12's last sentence, a weaker duplicate of the untrusted-evaluation rule. SEC-05 keeps it, and INP-12 drops the sentence and cites SEC-05.
E32 GATE-06's floor note (lint-url-literals needs 2.35) vs the measured floor of 2.34, below which the flag is a silent no-op. GATE-06 keeps the rule, and its floor note becomes 2.34.
E33 FLK-06, FLK Verdict 9 and the map treat NIX-MOD as conditional, but NIX-MOD ships. MOD-04 owns the module-evaluating check, FLK-06 cites it, and every 'conditional' qualifier is removed.

E34 GEN Verdict 10 lists four prototype breaks. The other families' rules add three: PKG-11 (no runHook, mk-package.nix:67,80), GATE-01 (bare nixfmt formatter) and INP-03 (rev in url without a comment). Each rule keeps its text, and the handoff and ADR list seven breaks.

E35 MOD's fleet commitment says the module sits 'next to package.nix' yet references ../package.nix, while PKG-06 bans ../ in package.nix. PKG-06 keeps its text, and the module wording becomes nix/module.nix with a ../package.nix default.

E36 PKG-07's MUST presence names homepage, but its jq does not check it; GEN-21 omits homepage when the index lacks it. The MUST set becomes description, license and platforms, homepage becomes SHOULD, and GEN-21 keeps the D text.
E37 REL-11's 'single attribute' heuristic vs GEN-14's check over the whole packages set. REL-11 is reworded to allow a packages set that carries no deprecation shims, and GEN-14 keeps its check.
E38 LANG-05 is a MUST whose only check is GATE-16's advisory Lix leg. Both keep their text. A Lix red on a mixed-rec merge is a MUST finding, and GATE-16 says so.

E39 LANG-02 ('reference files through interpolation') vs FLK-07 and PKG-15 (a ${src} read is forbidden). These govern different phases: build-time references vs eval-time reads. LANG-02 adds a pointer to FLK-07.

E40 FLK skeleton A (nixpkgs only) vs INP/E22 (nixpkgs plus flake-compat) and INP-09/PKG (ocx and grim declare self.submodules). FLK keeps skeleton A as the portable example. The adopt skill composes the fleet template and re-verifies it.
E41 SEC Applied adds SEC greps to the gate, but the canonical index gate block has none. The index gate block gains one security step, and security.md keeps the rules.
E42 MOD-04 is a MUST for every host, but its only watched recipe is NixOS. It becomes MUST for nixosModules and SHOULD for home and darwin hosts until M-I-09 is watched.
E43 LANG-08 overlaps index NIX-CORE-04 (read the era first). CORE-04 keeps the general rule, and LANG-08 keeps the diagnosis keying and cites CORE-04.
E44 LANG-04 vs SEC-04 on getEnv. LANG-04 keeps the purity half and SEC-04 the secret half, with cross-citations and one grep.

Carried and still unapplied in the consolidation text: E11 (GATE-09 triage row names an author defect via FLK-07), E12 (Lix leg adds flake-self-attrs), E13 (gate step 7 is INP-06's command), E14 (PKG-08 scoped per REL-11), E16 (FLK-07 example becomes ./Cargo.toml), E19 (PKG-01 builtin half cites INP-10), E27 (gate step 6 builds every own package).
authoring_notes: 1 Rule and globs: ship one rule, rules/nix-quality.md, with paths ["**/*.nix", "**/flake.lock", "**/statix.toml"] exactly. Never glob .envrc, workflows, treefmt.toml or data files; route to them by task. Keep the index under 200 lines. Put depth files in rules/nix-quality/ and do not chain them. Run the checker with --root ~/.cache/research-lang/exemplars/nix/nix-community__disko behind an if [ -d ] guard.

2 Depth files, by family. flakes.md NIX-FLK-01..19 draws on nix-flakes.md and applies E6, E16, E28, E33, E40. inputs.md NIX-INP-01..14 applies E13, E31. packaging.md NIX-PKG-01..19, 21, 22 applies E14, E19, E36; PKG-20 is retired. generated-flakes.md NIX-GEN-01..22 is the portable subset, with ocx as the worked example. gates.md NIX-GATE-01..16 applies E11, E12, E13, E27, E32, E38 and carries the PKG-20 cost note. release.md NIX-REL-01..17 applies E28, E29, E30, E37. language.md NIX-LANG-01..08, 10, 11 applies E39, E43, E44; LANG-09 is retired. security.md NIX-SEC-01..09 applies E30, E31, E41, E44. modules.md NIX-MOD-01..08 applies E33, E35, E42. The routing phrases are task-worded, and the full table is in the map.

3 Index-owned rules are NIX-CORE-01..06: never weaken a check; watch red first; state what empty output and each exit code mean; read the era first (nix --version plus the locked nixpkgs ref); identify the shape (A to E); treat generated files as marked, excluded, deterministic and never hand-edited. The index also holds the gate block, the non-negotiables, the routing table and the siblings. The gate block is GATE's nine steps with E12, E13 and E27 applied, plus FLK-16's git ls-files and one security-grep step (SEC-02, 03, 08, and SEC-04's pattern check). Every other rule is depth-owned.

4 Bounded duplication: the index non-negotiables list at most 15 one-line MUSTs, each ending in its ID (FLK-16, FLK-07 with PKG-15, FLK-08/09, FLK-12, FLK-19, PKG-03/04, PKG-05, REL-01/02, LANG-02, LANG-04, LANG-10, SEC-02, SEC-04, SEC-05, REL-11). Skills repeat a MUST only in a | # | Finding | Rule | table, never as a row that leads with the rule ID.

5 Pinned defaults. Q1: no FlakeHub. Q2: no public cache and no fleet nixConfig. Q3: by-name-ready now, nixpkgs later. Q4: ocx-sh/ocx-nix, with the generator as an ocx subcommand. Q5: keep every digest until 20 MB. Q6: CppNix gated, Lix and the floor advisory, Determinate untested. Q7: no fleet modules, but modules.md ships. Q8: the computed floor (nix_2_31 = 2.31.5). Carried defaults: the fleet systems x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux, aarch64-darwin on nixos-unstable; overlays.default; nixfmt-tree as a fleet MUST (in the adopt skill); nixpkgs plus flake-compat inputs; self.submodules for ocx and grim; stock rustPlatform plus the PKG-16 CI step; no crane or rust-overlay in fleet flakes; weekly lock PRs under the App token, merged by a human; no git SHA in ocx version; Q-LANG-1 and Q-LANG-2.

6 Drops, with IDs retired and never reused. NIX-LANG-09 becomes procedure steps in nix-diagnose. NIX-PKG-20 becomes a cost note under GATE-10, because it has no red/green check and changes no diff. Sentences dropped: INP-12's untrusted-eval sentence (E31), PKG-01's builtin half (E19), PKG-08's unscoped 'in CI' (E14), REL failure mode 9's Q13 wording (E30), FLK-07's ../Cargo.toml example (E16), and every 'conditional NIX-MOD' qualifier (E33).

7 Scope edits, each watched red and green before it ships: E28 (the version entry point in FLK-15 and REL-16); E29 (REL-16 binds A only, and REL-09 gets the D README form); E36 (PKG-07's presence set); E37 (REL-11's wording); E42 (MOD-04 is MUST for nixosModules, SHOULD elsewhere); E32 (GATE-06's floor is 2.34). SEC-06 requires 2.35.2 or later on the 2.35 line until a source read clears 2.35.0 and 2.35.1. For MOD-03 and MOD-06, run nix eval --json github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-26.05#lib.types --apply 't: t ? pathWith', repeat it on nixos-25.11, and record the floor.

8 Version dating: each depth file opens with an Era line ('Measured 2026-09-27 on CppNix 2.35.2, nixpkgs 26.11pre 8d5d2709; floor nix_2_31 = 2.31.5; Lix 2.95.2; nixfmt 1.5.0, deadnix 1.3.2, flake-checker 0.2.15'). Every rule keeps a Floor/impl cell. Volatile facts carry a date or version and a re-check trigger in parentheses. Never write 'recently' or 'now'. Every corpus rate says whether it excludes NixOS__nixpkgs.

9 Verification-command shape: pass an explicit directory operand (.); use one -e per alternative, with no | or \| alternation; quote --include globs and never leave ** unquoted; no $(...) and no process substitution, so a comparison becomes two commands whose outputs must match, or a checked-in fixture script; no angle-bracket placeholders anywhere, so use a concrete example attribute; always xargs -r; POSIX classes, not \s or \b, in grep -E; no unescaped pipe inside a markdown table cell, so move pipelines into a fenced sh block after the table; state what empty output and each exit code mean. These cells must be reshaped: PKG-05, PKG-11, PKG-16, REL-01, REL-02, REL-13, REL-16, SEC-06, SEC-07, INP-09, INP-11, INP-13, LANG-07, MOD-03, GEN-21, FLK-13 (self form). The fixtures are gone, so re-plant them under ~/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/fixtures/nix-authoring/<family>/, git init and add each one, and record the versions and whether the store was cold or warm.

10 Fences: tag Nix snippets nix and keep them nixfmt-clean (extract each to a file and run nixfmt --check). Tag shell snippets sh. Never tag Nix as python, because the repo runs ruff format over markdown.

11 Skills are procedures only. nix-flake-adopt covers the era, the shape, the composed fleet template (E40), the package.nix templates (Rust, the ocx workspace, the PKG-21 Python library), PKG-03 hashes, FLK-16, the gate, the nix.yml shape (GATE-12..16, the SEC-03 token), the REL-09 README and a modernize branch (M-K-05); it also carries the fleet commitments E3 and E21. nix-flake-release covers the gate, --all-systems and the legs, REL-01/02, REL-08, the tag, REL-16 with the PKG-19 entry point, REL-10, the nix-update contract (REL-13, REL-17), and D flakes (no tags; GEN-15). nix-diagnose covers CORE-04 and LANG-08 keying, the absorbed LANG-09 order, the LANG-10 classes, the 46-row evaluation-failures §3 catalog with C20 splits and a C7 section, GATE-09 triage with E11 applied, and 'explicitly not a defect'. No review skill and no generator skill. Bundle nix-essentials holds nix-quality, nix-flake-adopt, nix-flake-release and nix-diagnose, all untagged.

12 The ocx handoff has three parts. (a) The generated-flakes depth file. (b) The prototype at .agents/research/nix-generated-flakes/prototype/. It builds and smoke-runs actionlint, ninja, cmake and a synthetic corretto, and passes GEN-07, 11, 13, 17, 19 and the escaping half of GEN-20. It has seven breaks for ocx to fix before adoption: the GEN-20 self.env splice, GEN-20's first-token renderChunk, GEN-21's synthesised description with no homepage, GEN-22 silently ignoring entrypoints and dependencies, PKG-11 with no runHook (mk-package.nix:67,80), GATE-01's bare nixfmt, and INP-03's rev in url. (c) The ADR draft adr_nix_flake_generation.md for ocx-sh/ocx. It settles: the generator as an ocx subcommand reusing platform.rs:416 and the registry client; the repo and name ocx-sh/ocx-nix; the fetch (fetchurl with Bearer QQ==, the digest verbatim as the hash, and an Accept header on manifests); the attribute shape (flat latest packages, legacyPackages quoted versions, an overlay adding only ocx); the libc template (autoPatchelfHook everywhere, soname ignore lists); meta (provenance, split SPDX licenses omitted when missing, index description and homepage, mainProgram only for one binary); env, entrypoint and deps translation with self.env inlined; systems (aarch64-darwin eval-only, no x86_64-darwin, musl and Windows dropped); history; the update loop (App token, reviewed PR, per-item failure); yanked and deprecated handling; no cache and no nixConfig; executed README examples; the cmake-gui policy. It also asks the index for a required license annotation, upstream.repository_url for ocx/cli and ocx/mirror, a fix for the anonymous manifest 404s, signatures (M-E-20) and a resolved projection (M-E-29). M-E-10 (Darwin install_name and codesign) stays open.

13 MUST presentation: 83 MUSTs, most scoped to a shape (19 bind only D). Group rows by the check that catches them, state the shape binding in the Severity cell, and list only cross-shape MUSTs in the index. Rules checked by a reading heuristic say so (LANG-08, GATE-09 triage, SEC-01's own-cache judgement, SEC-07's auto-merge half).

14 The held-out round is binding in phase 8. Run every Verification cell verbatim over the 38-repo corpus and over five to eight fresh flakes at recorded SHAs (for example ryantm/agenix, nix-community/impermanence, NixOS/nixos-hardware, danth/stylix, nix-community/nh, numtide/devshell), plus the ocx prototype. Group each break by class C1-C25. A new instance becomes an Applied row. A new class or a new MUST revises the depth file with a revision-log line and does not reopen research.
